markets.question: Who will win in the upcoming basketball event DEN Nuggets vs IND Pacers scheduled for November 7, 2026 at 10:00 PM UTC?
markets.description: This market will settle to the winner of the DEN Nuggets vs IND Pacers professional basketball game scheduled for November 7, 2026 at 5:00PM ET (as of the listing of the event's first instrument). Overtime is included if played. If the game is delayed, postponed, suspended or otherwise rescheduled to a date and time not within two days of the originally scheduled date and time, the market will settle to the last fair market price. Outcome sourced from the relevant governing body.
